data.text: Protect a 90-minute focus block on two mornings. You have 2 such blocks a week; the expert has 9.
Leave a 15-minute gap between meetings. You have 6 back-to-back runs a week; the expert has 0.
Group your meetings into fewer stretches. Your week is chopped up at 0.62 on a scale of 0 to 1; the expert's is 0.31.
Schedule an off-computer break on most days. You have about 2.5 hours a week; the expert has about 5.0.
